snippet.title: PAPARAZZI (Wishlish Trailer)
snippet.description:
Wishlist PAPARAZZI on Steam : https://shorturl.at/HxXYF

PAPARAZZI is an online casual multiplayer game that oppose Stars and Paparazzis :
* Paparazzis must take pictures of the Stars without getting caught. Blend among a crowd of NPCs and take close up pictures to gain more cash. Just don't be too greedy !
* Stars must find the Paparazzis in the crowd and beat the shit out of them. Just avoid assaulting innocents, and don't forget to spend some time with your fans !

The richest player at the end of the timer win !
